subject: Subscription review & growth checkpoint — calendar poll and action items
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acme-corp.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Subscription review & capacity ask (renewal window Oct 15)

Hi Logan / Marissa,

Hope you both are well. Our October 15 renewal is approaching and leadership asked me to get a short subscription review on the calendar this week. A few items we want to cover:

- Current committed throughput (50 concurrent tokens) and actual peak usage (we've been seeing bursts up to 110 instances during promos)
- Options and pricing for stepping commitment to 100–150 concurrent capacity (we're targeting +2x usage next quarter)
- Any new SLA/observability features we should be aware of before renewing
- Timeline for a QBR and who from your side should attend

Can you send a couple of 30–45 minute slots? Also, please send any prep docs or a short SOW so I can loop in procurement early.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Torres
Director, AI Platforms | Acme Corp

Thanks Elena — looping in Marissa (account lead), Priyom (solutions eng) and Monica (renewals) so we have coverage for pricing, architecture, and procurement.

Quick internal notes / asks before we propose slots:
- Priyom — can you prepare a short delta-doc showing current perf at 110 bursts vs 150 target (latency, cost delta, and recommended batching/kv-cache settings)?
- Monica — please draft a stub SOW and two pricing bands (commit 100 / commit 150) we can share externally. Include one line for optional Dedicated burst credits.
- Marissa — please flag any discount guardrails; we should surface the existing list price and recommended uplift concession if any.

I will send Elena a 30–45 min poll with three options. Proposed internal attendees for the call: Logan (AM), Marissa (AE), Priyom (Solutions Eng), Monica (Customer Success). External: Elena + ACME procurement if available.

Attaching a first-pass SOW and a capacity forecast template for ACME to fill out.

Attachments: [ACME_Renewal_SOW_v0.9.pdf (PDF, 210 KB)], [Capacity_Forecast_Q3-Q4.xlsx (XLSX, 35 KB)]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Subscription review & growth checkpoint — proposed agenda + calendar poll

Elena — thanks for the quick reply earlier.

Proposed agenda for the 30–45m session (please pick one of the times in the Calendly poll below):

1) Brief usage/peak review (5–7m) — Priyom
2) Recommended commitment options and cost delta (10m) — Monica/Marissa
3) Migration/ops items (KV cache, batching, dedicated burst) and impact on latency (10m) — Priyom
4) Mutual action plan, procurement timeline, and next steps (5–10m) — Logan

Calendar poll: https://calendly.com/logan-wright/acme-renewal-review

Quick mutual action plan (MAP) — items we will bring and ask ACME to bring: 
- Redwood: draft SOW, two pricing bands (commit 100 / commit 150), capacity impact doc, sample contract amendment
- ACME: completed capacity forecast, procurement contact and PO lead, list of business-critical routes for SLA prioritization

Pre-reads attached: ACME_Renewal_SOW_v0.9.pdf, Capacity_Forecast_Q3-Q4.xlsx

If possible, can Procurement join the same call? If not, we'll include them on the MAP and follow up with the SOW/DocuSign link.

On cost, as a ballpark: moving from your current commit to 100 committed units would be approximately +21% list price (before any incentive) and 150 committed ~ +45% list. Final numbers will be in the SOW Monica is preparing.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

— Logan
